counterfactual_document.title: Calibration-only counterfactual domestic lodging policy
counterfactual_document.content: This is a counterfactual calibration document only; it does not replace the workshop policy. In this control document, starting July 1, 2026, the domestic business-trip lodging limit is KRW 900000 per person per night. A receipt is required; above-limit costs follow advance approval in APPROVAL-01. Actual payment and approval decisions belong to the responsible staff member.

case.question: What is the domestic lodging limit per night for September 2026?

controls.response: The limit is KRW 150000 per person per night. A receipt is required, and above-limit costs need team-lead approval before booking. I am not granting approval or making a payment. [TRAVEL-2026] [APPROVAL-01]
